data.text:
PRESIDENT RAMAPHOSA DESCRIBES LIMPOPO FLOODS AS DEVASTATING 

MBAULA – President Matamela Cyril Ramaphosa, accompanied by Limpopo Premier Dr Phophi Ramathuba, visited the province to assess the impact of recent flooding following the confirmation of nine fatalities linked mainly to drowning incidents since the festive season.

The President and Premier received a detailed briefing on the status of floods and their impact in the Mopani District before proceeding to inspect some of the worst-affected areas, including Manila Village. 

Authorities warned that parts of Mopani and Vhembe districts remain at high risk, with the South African Weather Service forecasting a possible storm later this evening.

As a precautionary measure, the Limpopo Disaster Management Centre has been closed, with emergency teams evacuating numerous residents trapped in the north-eastern parts of the province.

Since 25 December 2025, a total of nine fatalities have been reported, most of them resulting from drowning-related incidents. 

Speaking to the media, Ramaphosa described the floods as devastating. 

Residents are urged to remain vigilant and adhere to safety warnings as emergency services continue monitoring the situation. 

#PolokwaneWeekly
